title: pricebook -- the economics plane's data artifact (pricebook.yaml) and the cost{} field-group
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/pricebook.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = the pricebook.yaml artifact (pricebook.md sec 1: header/defaults + skus map; the book prices SKUs <weights>@<host>/<service_tier>, not lanes). Reader liberality (sec 6, G4): readers MUST ignore unknown SKU fields (new pricing dimensions arrive quarterly) and MUST NOT invent absent capabilities (absent cache_read_mult = no cache; absent batch_kind = none; absent warmer_release = on_complete; absent stacks_with_cache = better-of-two). A row failing its REQUIRED fields does not parse -- the loader refuses the whole file with the row named. One law: a row without a date does not parse; an unpriced lane does not run; an unreservable call does not dispatch. $defs carry the canonical cost{} field-group (sec 5.2, R16) and the conductor-ledger SPEND record (sec 5.1 -- NOT a Medium type).

version.$comment: COMPUTED: sha256 of canonical content; every spend record cites it -- costs recomputable forever against the book they were priced under

signature.$comment: REQUIRED at Stage-1b+: operator signature over version (custody/verification: identity-firewall.md B-Annex-2; a book failing verification at Stage-1b+ is REFUSED entirely; below Stage-1b the loader warns and proceeds -- sec 6)

stale_mult.$comment: estimation-only pessimism multiplier; applied UPWARD only (rule 3)

refuse_after.$comment: lane REFUSED at age > refuse_after x max_age_days (rule 4; flag-overridable)

skus.$comment: sec 1.2 -- key = <weights>@<host>/<service_tier> for token rows (unknown service_tier strings are legal, sec 6); tool.<capability>@<provider>/<tier> for non-token lanes

verified_flag.$comment: true|false|mixed|bench (sec 1.2); verified:false rows are quotable but every quote/receipt carries the flag (rule 9)

token_sku.$comment: sec 1.2 token SKU row. A lane = {sku, effort, cache_mode, batch}: lane dimensions modify token counts/multipliers over one SKU's unit prices, never the unit prices. additionalProperties true per sec 6 reader liberality (unknown SKU fields ignored). in/out REQUIRED for token rows (sec 6) EXCEPT requires_contract rows, which are custom-priced via an operator-written contract_price block (rules 9; seed row kimi-k2.6@cerebras/dedicated) -- hence not schema-required here

weights_family.$comment: REQUIRED. The diversity axis (A6); consumed by the oracle seat's quorum solver + the router's diversity floor. For third-party hosts a CLAIM, trustworthy only under lane-family attestation = signed book (declaration) + runtime canary (reality; oracle.md SEC-2, s6-13). TWO FLAGS, TWO OWNERS: the trust DIVERSITY flag is family_verified (trust-plane-owned, never a field of this book) -- diversity-counting gates on family_verified, NEVER parity_verified

parity_verified.$comment: the ECON COST-parity flag (pricebook-owned; s6-13 split). Third-party serving of open weights => parity probe required (5 paired pulls vs first-party, |dScore| <= 0.05). Cost/routing parity ONLY -- diversity-counting MUST NOT key on this flag. A family_verified canary mismatch also flips this false + row stale; the diversity-contribution-ZERO law is family_verified's (oracle.md SEC-2), never this flag's

in.$comment: REQUIRED (token rows). Cache-MISS sticker input price, usd/1M

out_batched.$comment: appears on local rows in the sec 2 seed (batched-throughput electricity price)

cache_read_mult.$comment: multiplier on in for cache-hit tokens; ABSENT => no cache capability (read=1.0). Per-SKU FACT, never per-weights

cache_storage_usd_per_1M_hr.$comment: NEW v5: explicit-cache storage RENT; quote() adds rent x expected_hold_hours

cache_min_prompt_tokens.$comment: NEW v5: minimum cacheable prompt; below it, cache terms drop out

max_cache_breakpoints.$comment: appears on anthropic rows in the sec 2 seed

warmer_release.$comment: when N-1 staggered callers may read the warmer's prefix; default on_complete; an optimistic on_ttft elsewhere silently pays N writes

batch_kind.$comment: endpoint = real async batch API; window = off-peak clock discount (enum kept for schema stability); none = batch dims inadmissible

batch_window_max_h.$comment: NEW v5: the booked OUTER completion bound; sla admissibility keys on THIS; ABSENT with batch_kind:endpoint => 24

stacks_with_cache.$comment: whether batch_mult x cache_read_mult compose; null => PESSIMISTIC better-of-two at quote

effort_map.$comment: OPTIONAL provider effort/reasoning dial -> param map; effort changes COUNTS, never unit price

context_tiers.$comment: long-context surcharges; straddle rule: the higher tier prices the WHOLE call when the estimate straddles the boundary

effective_until.$comment: scheduled price/existence cliff; a provider-announced deprecation date is an effective_until -- past it without successor the lane is REFUSED (rule 6)

successor.$comment: applied automatically at the effective_until date (no silent under-reservation)

requires_contract.$comment: NEW v5: live lane, custom-priced; quote() REFUSES unless the operator has written a contract_price block. Never estimated

contract_price.$comment: operator-written prices for requires_contract rows (rule 9; shape prose-only in the .md)

tokenizer.$comment: NEW v5: cross-SKU token-estimate conversion; the frame manifest's est_tokens is PER-FAMILY; ABSENT => one universal estimate with declared error

tok_s_p50.$comment: LEDGER-DERIVED (rolling p50, last 200 calls); hand-seeded only until 20 calls accrue (rule 7); never hand-edited after

liveness.$comment: LOCAL rows only; SET BY PREFLIGHT (substrate seam), never by hand

capex_amort.$comment: OPTIONAL; default OFF -- sovereignty accounting counts marginal cost

as_of.$comment: REQUIRED (present); age = today - as_of drives rules 2-4. Local rows carry null until the bench job sets it (rule 8)

source.$comment: REQUIRED. Primary docs > vendor page > aggregator > bench

promo_until.$comment: a promo price MUST NOT be booked without its expiry; book the LIST price and note the promo

tool_sku.$comment: sec 1.2 non-token (tool) lane: acts reserve here under purpose=tool. Unknown pricing_model strings are NOT legal (the escrow cannot compute worst-case for a model it does not know => row unreservable, sec 6)

worst_case.$comment: expression, e.g. timeout_s x per_second; a tool act with no computable worst-case is UNRESERVABLE => REFUSED (act seam)

leaseable.$comment: NEW v5: eligible for sec 4.5 res:lease micro-escrow (high-rate H0 lanes)

cost.$comment: sec 5.2 -- the canonical cost{} field-group riding Medium records that already cross (receipt / act_receipt / cmd_receipt / verdict / StackReceipt): fleet-visible spend attribution WITHOUT a new payload type (v2 sec 7 kept; v3's Medium type:spend repealed -- rulings #687/#694). Exactly six members (R16); wall_ms is NOT a member (it is a sibling measurement field on the carrying record, oracle.md 5.1). Escrow truth-home = the conductor's own ledger; these groups are the cross-check join

sku.$comment: redacted to a hashed lane id in operator-external exports (identity-firewall B-Annex-2)

purpose.$comment: the canonical purpose enum (sec 5.1; same set as the SPEND record and budget.purposes scopes)

spend_record.$comment: sec 5.1 -- SPEND record on the conductor's own fsync'd ledger; NOT a Medium type (spend-home ruling). Scope counters are in-memory folds over RESERVE/COMMIT/RELEASE/SPEND records, rebuilt on restart

issuer.$comment: claim-id, or conductor for plane-side calls

attribution.$comment: NEW v5 (#683b): apparatus => NOT charged to arm.usd_spent for the dollar-UCB index; folds run-level apparatus_usd

usd_sticker.$comment: all tokens at cache-miss -- the counterfactual

usd_effective.$comment: at booked multipliers -- what we believe we owe

usd_reserved.$comment: the escrow worst-case this call held

api_reported_usd.$comment: provider-reported actual where the API returns one

retries.$comment: each retry attempt is a NEW reservation (sec 4.1)

outcome.$comment: in-doubt spend commits at worst case under outcome=unknown (reconcile, sec 4.2)

batch_id.$comment: res:durable legs carry the provider batch_id
